annotations.title: Overview: What Happened and What Needs You

description: The dashboard Overview for the last hours (default 24, at most 168, or since an ISO time). Whether each app is covered (data flowing, firewall on, detection monitoring or blocking, with what is missing); attack requests, attackers, requests the firewall stopped, and attacks that got through (whose impact check found possible or confirmed impact; null when none was checked), with attacks per hour; the decisions waiting for a person (block recommendations, coverage problems, apps ready to block, detection promotions); the top attackers (verdict, score, what they tried, apps, requests, whether blocked); and what SecureNow did (the agent's actions, automatic blocks, failed probes and rule-fix closes, learned exclusions).

attackers.description: How many top attackers to list (default 8).

since.description: Start of the window as an ISO time, at most 7 days ago; used instead of hours.
